releases.displayName: A second patch has been released with some bug fixes and small changes

items.text: I've been hard at work on a new patch with some more bug fixes and small changes! Patch notes are below:

-Some players did not receive their trinkets as a reward for returning lost spirits. If this happened to you, loading into the game with the new build should now add these missing trinkets to your inventory. This bug likely happened if you left the room before collecting the reward. -Fixed a bug where it would replay your death animation if you teleported while dying.
-Fixed a bug where entering the spa water did not heal the player
-Fixed an issue where the pricing of items in the shop sometimes did not match
-Fixed a bug where healing during a "Complete without taking damage" challenge would end the fight.
-Removed a leftover debug that skipped the storyline involving piecing Looter back together.
-Fixed some spots where the player could get stuck
-Fixed a bug where the Melted Candle trinket would not always work properly when upgraded
-Fixed a missing glyph in the Traditional Chinese translation
-Altered the way the in-game timer counts up, since there was a bug with it counting up on the menu.
-Prevented you from opening the map on the main menu screen
-Fixed a bug where the stone ball can get stuck inside of a platform in Autumn Forest
-I had reports of users getting stuck during the Dollmaker boss fight. I couldn't reproduce but I made some changes that should hopefully prevent this from happening.
-The game no longer will show a lock icon on the map after defeating the queen (only when starting a new game). This wasn't a bug, but it was confusing so I changed it.

-Fixed a bug where it would lock you out of an achievement if you save/exited or teleported away during the campfire scene in the bog. When you load into a save file, it should re-trigger this achievement.
-Fixed various small visual issues and inconsistencies
-Teleporting now refills your flaming vessels
-Updated the Japanese translation
-On easy difficulty, the Innkeeper chase now has checkpoints
I'm still going through reports but this should be the bulk of issues I saw reported. Thanks so much!
-Kyle

releases.displayName: THANK YOU for the amazing launch! The first update is here!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45730060/e35279855fc08fc0a74185646249c7ed03f216d3.png"]

Thank you all so much for such an amazing launch day! I am extremely grateful for all the support, and I am really happy seeing all the feedback coming in from the game. The response has been so much more than I expected, and I'm working hard to respond to every one and also put out a first patch.

I've been listening to all your feedback and I've been working on a first patch, in order to address what seem to be the most important changes (bugs, missing rebinding keys, screenshots and video recording via Steam not working, a save issue, etc), and then I will work on another patch with some less urgent changes afterwards.

It's been a busy day or two, but as you read this post the first patch should be available! I have a lot more on my todo list, but I wanted to get a quick patch up to fix some of the larger bugs at launch.
Prevented a possible save corruption if you pause the game on the same frame that you save.
Fixed a bug where your save tent displays wrong if you beat the drain boss but do not rescue the frogs.
Allows you to rebind to Alt
Fixed a bug where the camera doesn't follow the player in certain time trials if the camera zoom setting is too wide.
Taking screenshots with F12 should now be working as should recording videos on Steam, if it doesn't still please leave a comment and a way to contact you
Fixed a couple out of bounds spots
Fixed a spot where you could get stuck in a wall in The Docks
Fixed the Looter's Shop Achievement from only triggering when buying trinkets
Slightly altered the wall jump allowances
Other misc small bug fixes and changes

NOTE: While the save corruption bug should not happen anymore, and it seems to have been a very rare freak coincidence of several factors that lead to it, if you have experienced the bug in the original build there may be ways to fix your save:
Go to C:\\Users\\Your Name\\AppData\\Local\\WellDweller , and delete the file titled "Settings"

Hover over your save file, it should be titled something like "WellDweller1". If this file is more than 0kb, you should be able to play as normal. If the file is 0kb, the file is unfortunately corrupt and you should delete it.

Look for a file titled something like "BACKUP_WellDweller1", hover over it and verify it is more than 0kb. If it is, rename it to match the deleted save file ("WellDweller1" for example) and it should fix the issue
-Kyle Thompson
I wanted to put out one small update on the demo before Next Fest with a few changes based on common feedback:

1. I made some additional changes to the bubble mechanic. I changed some level design to make the onboarding a lot more gradual, and I redesigned some of the more frustrating rooms. I also added in some slight aim assist in certain spots where the movement is otherwise a bit finicky. I'll play around with this all a bit more, but I wanted to make some quick changes on that now.
2. In a couple optional challenge rooms that are far from save points, I added in some additional healing spots.
3. Some other small bug/localization fixes.
Thanks for checking out the demo and for giving all your feedback! I really appreciate it,
-Kyle

releases.displayName: New demo update and Steam Next Fest participation!

items.text: Hey everybody!

This is just a quick update note to say that the Well Dweller demo has been updated! Although the content broadly stays the same, there have been some bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and some smoothing based upon feedback to earlier versions of the demo and private playtesting.
There are some additions though, which are the inclusion of a postbox where you can recieve letters from the characters you meet, and the ability to replay time trials.

Lastly, to note, Well Dweller will be taking part in Steam Next Fest beginning on June 15! If you didn't get a chance to try the game yet, or only partially completed a play through, now's a great time to return to it! Thanks for all your support!

releases.displayName: A small demo update has gone live!

items.text: Thanks so much every one for playing the demo and giving your feedback! I just uploaded a small update on the demo with three changes based on common feedback:

Some players experienced a silent crash, either during loading, or immediately after the intro cutscene. This is hard to debug since I can't recreate it, but I think I fixed it so let me know if you still experience this crash in the newest build!

I had a lot of comments on the bubble mechanic being a bit hard to aim. I made a couple small changes there which allow the movement to be more forgiving and I also updated the UI to make it easier to tell how close you need to get to the bubbles and which direction to aim.

I added a tiny bit of "coyote time" onto the oil flask healing mechanic. There is already an early trinket (you can find it in the demo in the hunters cabin) that can allow for a much larger window, and the mechanic becomes a bit second nature as you play longer, but I figured it could be a little less precise. Especially since it tosses you into a boss fight pretty much immediately after learning the mechanic, which was maybe a bit cruel lol
Thanks so much again for playing the demo! I am so happy with the feedback and turnout, I'm really excited for you all to play the full game when it releases this year!
-Kyle
